summary: A small URL shortener service with persistence, an HTTP API, tests, Docker, and CI.

stages.title: Development Environment
stages.objective: Set up the development environment: Go module, Dockerfile, compose, and test scripts.

stages.title: Core URL service
stages.objective: Implement short-code generation and resolution as a unit-tested core package.
acceptance_criteria: a code round-trips to its URL

stages.title: Persistence layer
stages.objective: Persist URL mappings so they survive a restart.

stages.title: HTTP API
stages.objective: Expose create and resolve endpoints over HTTP.

stages.title: Integration and packaging
stages.objective: Wire persistence and API together, add integration tests, Docker, and CI.
